name: weakness-policy
effect: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.
shortEffect: Held: When the holder is hit by a super effective move, its Attack and Special Attack raise by two stages.

flavorTextEntries.text: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Attack and Sp. Atk sharply increase if the holder is hit with a move it’s weak to.
